title: OAuth sign-in succeeds but the app reports 'Missing scope gmail.send'
symptoms: Sign-in completes with no error on Google's side
cause: Google's consent screen shows a checkbox for each requested scope and the user can leave one unticked. Sign-in still succeeds, with fewer scopes than requested.
fix: Repeat the sign-in and tick every scope checkbox on the consent screen. In your own apps, check the granted scopes in the token response and explain what is missing.
apply: Compare the scope field of the token response with the scopes you requested before proceeding.
